scene.ko: 연체료를 확인하러 갔다가 이미 반납한 책이 미반납으로 나와 있는 것을 함께 해결하고, 사서에게 찾는 자료를 도와 달라고 한다.

lines.en: Hi. I got an email about a late fee. Could you tell me what it's for?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 연체료가 있다는 이메일을 받았는데요. 무엇 때문인지 알려 주시겠어요?
alt: Hi. I got an email about a late fee. What is it for?
Hello. The library emailed me about a late fee. Can you tell me why?

lines.en: Let me see. You returned a cookbook three days late, so that's $1.50. And there's a travel guide that's two weeks overdue.
lines.ko: 볼게요. 요리책을 사흘 늦게 반납하셔서 1달러 50센트예요. 그리고 여행 안내서가 2주째 연체 중이에요.

lines.en: That's strange. I'm sure I returned them together in the drop box. Would you mind checking again?
lines.ko: 이상하네요. 분명히 두 권을 같이 반납함에 넣었거든요. 다시 한번 확인해 주시겠어요?
alt: That's odd. I put both books in the drop box together. Could you check again?
Really? I returned them both at the same time in the drop box. Can you take another look?

lines.en: Of course. Let me check the shelves... You're right, it's here. It just wasn't checked in properly. I'm sorry about that.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 서가를 확인해 볼게요... 맞네요, 여기 있어요. 반납 처리가 제대로 안 됐나 봐요. 죄송합니다.

lines.en: No problem. I'm glad it turned up. I'll pay the $1.50 for the cookbook.
lines.ko: 괜찮아요. 찾아서 다행이에요. 요리책 연체료 1달러 50센트는 낼게요.
alt: That's okay. Good thing you found it. I'll pay the late fee for the cookbook.
No worries. I'm glad you found it. Let me pay the $1.50.

lines.en: Actually, since the mix-up was our fault, I'll clear the whole fee for you.
lines.ko: 사실 이번 일은 저희 실수였으니 연체료를 전부 없애 드릴게요.

lines.en: Oh, thank you. While I'm here, could you help me find some materials? I'd like to learn more about the history of this town.
lines.ko: 아, 감사합니다. 온 김에 자료 찾는 것 좀 도와주실 수 있을까요? 이 동네 역사에 대해 더 알아보고 싶어서요.
alt: Thank you so much. Also, could you help me find something? I want to learn about the town's history.
That's really kind. By the way, I'm looking for materials on the history of this town. Could you help me?

lines.en: Sure. We have a local history section on the second floor, and you can also search old newspapers on our website.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 2층에 지역 역사 코너가 있고, 저희 웹사이트에서 옛날 신문도 검색하실 수 있어요.

lines.en: That sounds perfect. Is there any way to borrow books from other libraries if you don't have what I need?
lines.ko: 딱 좋네요. 여기 없는 책은 다른 도서관에서 빌릴 방법이 있을까요?
alt: Great. If you don't have a book, can I borrow it from another library?
Perfect. Can I get books from other libraries if they're not here?

lines.en: Yes, through interlibrary loan. Just fill out a request online, and it usually takes about a week.
lines.ko: 네, 상호대차로 가능해요. 온라인으로 신청서를 작성하시면 보통 일주일쯤 걸려요.

expressions.note: 다른 도서관의 책을 빌려 오는 서비스
